_comment: Settings for run_s3_vlm.py. Relative paths resolve against vlm_scripts_reports/ (the project root, not scripts/). Prompts (final_prompts), prices, checks and the model's max_output_tokens come from vlm_run/configs/config.json. Command-line options override these values.
_layout_note: Every object under source ending in head_suffix is one episode, in either layout: <station>/<date>/<taskNN>/<episode>/<name>_head.mp4 or <station>/<taskNN>/<episode>/<name>_head.mp4 (no date folder). The task is its whole path (station1/2026-11-21/task01), so equal task names of different stations or dates stay separate; the prompt gets the task folder name (task01). --source s3://.../station2/2026-11-22/ runs one folder; --task station1, station1/2026-11-21, station1/2026-11-21/task01 or task01 narrows the run. Head view only. Inventory 2026-11-24: station1 799, station2 112, station3 260 episodes (reports/s3_head_video_summary.csv).
_resolution_note: Gemini media_resolution low: about 280 tokens per image. long_side_px / jpeg_quality: size of the JPEG sent (null = the v2 config's frames values, 768 px / 80).
_thinking_note: Gemini generationConfig.thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel: minimal, low, medium, high (null = model default, which used ~10.5k thinking tokens for a 590-token answer on task01/episode_000004). Checked against the live API on 2026-11-24: 'medium' accepted, invalid values rejected with HTTP 400. Added when the batch file is written, so changing it needs no re-sampling; recorded in job.json and every vlm_result.json.
_max_output_note: Output cap per episode (answer + thinking). 65,536 is Gemini 3.8 Flash's outputTokenLimit (models API, 2026-11-24). Only generated tokens are billed, so a higher cap costs nothing unless used. Largest seen so far: 23,057 (task06/26, 3 fps, default thinking). Set when the batch file is written (no re-sampling).
_retry_note: Episodes that end without a parsed answer (finish reason MAX_TOKENS, unparseable or missing) are sent once more in a small second batch with thinking_level retry_thinking_level; the result records the thinking level actually used.
_prompt_set_note: Key of vlm_run/configs/config.json prompt.sets (--prompts overrides). final_v1.2 (2026-11-24): adds canonical_task (generic task of the task folder, named first in the answer; context.task_folder is sent) and states that no recording is calibration or inspection. final = the 1.0 set used for the earlier runs.
_batch_note: All episodes go into ONE Gemini Batch API job (half price) as an uploaded JSONL file (Files API, up to 2 GB), so long episodes (e.g. task04 episode_000000: ~460 images at 3 fps, ~38 MB) fit. A second job is created only if the JSONL would exceed max_batch_mb. Batch jobs finish in minutes to 24 h; an interrupted wait is picked up with --resume.
_workers_note: Episodes downloaded and decoded in parallel processes while preparing the requests.
_results_note: Everything of one episode in one folder: <results_dir>/<task path>/<episode>/ (<name>_vlm_result.json, step_table.json, frames/ and raw_response.json with debug), e.g. results/station1/2026-11-21/task01/episode_000000/. Plus <results_dir>/summary.csv (task path, prompt version, canonical task, task, count and the three confidences per episode) and <results_dir>/batches/<id>/job.json. An episode is done only when its result has a parsed response from the current prompt set; a result of an earlier prompt version (e.g. final_prompts 1.0 in results/station2/2026-11-22/) is redone and overwritten.
_upload_note: Each parsed result is also written (same file name) into the S3 folder of its MP4: <...>/<episode>/<name>_head.mp4 -> <...>/<episode>/<name>_vlm_result.json, replacing an earlier result there. Episodes without a parsed response are not uploaded (an older S3 result then stays). --no-upload keeps everything local.
